Class Rankings

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.Rankings
public final class Rankings extends Object
Top lists that leaderboard holograms (/holo create <name> top:<id>) can show. The Holograms plugin offers Core's leaderboards and number placeholders by itself; a plugin that knows its own ranking better (every player, online or not) registers it here: 
Rankings.register("mymod_dragons", new Rankings.Ranking() {
    public Message title() { return Message.translation("server.mymod.board.title"); }
    public List<Rankings.Entry> top(int count) {
        return MyMod.topSlayers(count).stream()
                .map(s -> new Rankings.Entry(s.name(), Message.raw(s.kills() + " dragons"))).toList();
    }
});
Rankings.unregister("mymod_dragons");   // in shutdown()
top() is called on the Holograms timer thread, at most every few seconds and only while a player is near one of its holograms; keep it quick.
